adjudication_summary: Worker-6 accepts this paper as publication-grade with cautions after a bounded worker-2/worker-4/worker-6 source re-review: Table 1/2 MIC rows, supplementary toxicity/salt rows, database conflicts, and mechanism claims were reopened from paper-local XML/PDF/DOCX/database sources, and no blocking rework target remains.
summary: Worker-6 re-review confirms accepted-with-cautions status after reopening the handoff packet, XML/PDF text, DOCX supplement tables, figure locators, and linked database snapshots; remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions, with no open rework target or unrecoverable material gap.

paper_xml.coverage: article identifiers, antimicrobial activity methods, Tables 1/2 MIC matrix, mechanism sections, and figure captions

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text checked for MIC/toxicity/mechanism/MBC search terms and figure-level mechanism context

oa_package.coverage: PMC package nxml/pdf/docx and figure image members inventoried; XML/DOCX text surfaces used for repair

supplementary_assets.coverage: DOCX Tables S4, S5, S6, and S7 parsed; S5/S7 used for toxicity/salt-stability repair; no spreadsheet supplement exists

merged_database_rows.coverage: 65 DBAASP assay rows, 72 linked experiment rows, and 14 literature rows reconciled or preserved as database-only provenance

supplementary_assets.note: DOCX supplement was parsed directly for Tables S4/S5/S7; supplement extraction artifact remains a prior inventory surface, not the acceptance proof.

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: The material packet remains separate from the final decision: XML/PDF/OA/DOCX/database surfaces were reopened from paper-local paths and are sufficient for the owner-layer repair.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: The validator/file contract is distinct from publication-grade acceptance; final acceptance is based on the source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 repair plus strict gate reruns.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 resolved the former broad source_conflict set by matching DBAASP/APD6 rows to primary Tables 1/2, Supplementary Tables S4/S5/S7, Figure 2D/prose, and article metadata. Two DBAASP rows remain database_only_no_primary_source cautions rather than fabricated primary evidence.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 repaired Table 1, expanded Table 2, recovered supplementary hemolysis/MHC and salt-stability rows, and preserved one qualitative HEK293T cytotoxicity statement without inventing numeric viability values.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated locator notes with source-backed mechanism claims limited to targeting-domain selection, LTA binding, membrane depolarization, membrane integrity/morphology, and in vivo phenotype support.
per_layer_decision_rationale.final_review: The prior rwk-complete-test-0001 issue is resolved; remaining uncertainties are nonblocking cautions visible in database statuses and caution_findings.

caution_findings.note: DBAASP MBC90 8 µM for SFK2 against S. aureus ATCC 6538 was not recovered in XML/PDF/DOCX primary surfaces; retained as database-only provenance and excluded from primary activity evidence.
DBAASP salt-stability MIC rows for SFK2 compress condition-specific Table S7 values; final records preserve salt conditions from the supplement.
HEK293T cytotoxicity is supported qualitatively by primary text/Figure 2D; no numeric cell-viability value was extracted or fabricated.
The packet has no linked_sequence_records rows; peptide sequences and amidation are source-reviewed from Supplementary Table S4 and database comments/literature links.
Direct mechanism claims are limited to SFK2/LTA and membrane assays; broad protein- or nucleic-acid mechanism notes from the scaffold were removed.
